pages.title: Snot a Problem
pages.text: Snot a Problem is the level of Earthworm Jim (Shiny Entertainment, 1994) in which Jim has no weapons. Instead, he swings on a rope against Major Mucus, and he must ram him into the walls until his rope snaps. VGMPF credits the music to Keith Arem.

pages.title: Three rounds
pages.text: In Snot a Problem, a level of Earthworm Jim, Jim fights three bouts, each time with a smarter Major Mucus. Sega Retro adds that from the second bout a monster at the bottom of the screen tries to eat Jim.

pages.title: On vinyl
pages.text: In 2017 Black Screen Records released an Earthworm Jim Anthology on vinyl, with music from the first two Earthworm Jim games. Its track list includes "Snot a Problem", according to DualShockers.
